decisions.reason: As the combined robot is now the stronger integrated successor within the automation portfolio after B was withdrawn, its strategic fit is high and the option value of keeping it open still exceeds likely carrying costs.

The profile storage robot remains a more niche complement to the plant offering, but in a broad project business the firm would usually wait longer before abandoning such a specialized option unless weak demand becomes clearer.
The stand-alone shuttering robot still offers a modular entry point for customers not buying the full combined solution, even though overlap with A makes it somewhat more vulnerable to later pruning.
Because this 2024 product line is very recent, offered in several models, and fits the firm's established automation workflow, uncertainty is still unresolved and it is worth keeping on the market.
Production analysis software deepens the firm's integrated equipment-and-service model and is comparatively inexpensive to carry, so management would be inclined to keep this option open.
